usedFor: Appcues holds onboarding flows, and Google Meet gets a review call through “Schedule a Meeting” for each new flow.

bestTemplate.name: “When one or more flows are created” in Appcues, then “Schedule a Meeting” in Google Meet
bestTemplate.why: A newly built flow gets a Google Meet review on the calendar before users ever see it.

watchOut: “When one or more flows are created” is polling, so the meeting is scheduled after a short delay.
